compose_closed_programs_museum.problem: Referral Lab needs honest counterexamples. People who see the Claim Shredder and the Rules Board need proof that the lab also records programs they cannot join: closed, capped or geo-excluded. That proof must never become a FOMO list, a disguised join funnel or an earnings pitch. The Closed Programs Museum is a calm, bilingual (zh-CN primary, English secondary), static evidence archive. Each row shows its status, as_of, official source, page_read and verified_on freshness, and a wall-label reason why it is not joinable. There are no CTAs, codes, referral parameters, earnings or network activity, and 点击 ≠ 收入 / Clicks ≠ income and the not-investment-advice disclosure are always in view.
do: Build the museum as a quiet archive of closed, capped, and geo-excluded counterexamples; link it internally from Claim Shredder and the Rules Board, never from an external brand.
Put `status`, `as_of`, official `source_url`, `page_read`, `verified_on`, and bilingual `why_not_joinable` on every row and render all of them visibly.
Keep the attribution bar `点击 ≠ 收入 / Clicks ≠ income` and the standing bilingual disclosure visible on every view.

Use the dark board tokens, restrained museum-label/tombstone annotation, bilingual zh-primary/en-secondary copy, responsive cards, keyboard access, WCAG AA, and reduced-motion behavior specified below.

Pre-render every row statically with data-freshness="unconfirmed", then let the client compute current / stale / unconfirmed from page_read, verified_on and the injected client date (90-day window, inclusive). "Current" means only that the evidence is fresh, never that the program is open.

Show 未核实 / Not yet checked against the official page as as_of, and 候选官方来源，尚未读取 / Candidate official source, not yet read as the source label, whenever page_read !== true. Seed every row this way until an official page has actually been read.
Render the reason as a quiet museum wall label (展签 / Wall label · 为何不可加入 / Why not joinable): hairline frame, zh line first, en line muted, with no icon, no cross or RIP imagery, and no joke.

Render each source as one plain underlined text link to the exact official https URL (no query, no hash), with target="_blank", rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" and referrerpolicy="no-referrer". It is the only link in a card.
Validate each row against the schema and INV-01 to INV-09 at build time (fail the build) and again on the client on every filter pass (hide the row and count it in [data-rejected-notice]).
Keep all search, filter, sort and expand behaviour in memory on the client, with zero requests after load, self-hosted fonts, and no cookies or Web Storage.
Move any program whose official page shows it has reopened out of the museum and onto the rules board for a fresh verification, and say so in the internal nav note.
Link back with the exact texts 回到 Claim Shredder / Back to Claim Shredder (/lab/claim-shredder) and 查看规则板 / View rules board (/lab/rules-board).
dont: Never provide a join/apply CTA, referral/share link, code field, or FOMO treatment for a closed, capped, geo-excluded, stale, or unverified row.
Never omit `as_of`, official source, or the bilingual reason why the program is not joinable; never present stale evidence as current.
Never use earnings estimates, take-rate calculators, 「你能拿」, guaranteed income, 必赚, 10000x, urgency, confetti, neon, LIVE, countdown, investment advice, or gravity.li/GRAVITY branding.
Never generate, store, infer, or add referral codes or `ref`/`via`/`code` outbound parameters; this feature has no `{own_link}`.
Never hide or weaken `点击 ≠ 收入 / Clicks ≠ income`.
Ban earnings estimates (lexicon: earnings_estimate), including reward amounts, per-referral figures and "estimated/potential earnings".

Ban take-rate calculators (lexicon: take_rate_calculator), including number or range inputs and <output>, and ban any percentage, fee-share rate or take rate in visible text (lexicon: rate_or_percentage).
Ban 「你能拿」 and every "you can earn / you will get" framing (lexicon: ni_neng_na).
Ban guaranteed income, risk-free, passive-income, 保证收入, 稳赚 and 躺赚 claims (lexicon: guaranteed_income).
Ban 必赚 and 包赚 (lexicon: bi_zhuan).
Ban 10000x and every N×/N倍 multiplier (lexicon: multiplier_10000x).

Do not state cap figures, jurisdiction lists, reward amounts or fee-share rates that have not been read on the official page, and never state reward amounts or rates at all.
Do not load third-party fonts, analytics or any runtime data. Do not persist filter state.

ia.rendering: Static pre-render at build time: every valid seed row is emitted as HTML, together with the honesty bar and the standing disclosure. A small inline module then (a) computes freshness from data-page-read, data-verified-on and the injected client date and relabels each row, (b) filters, searches and sorts by toggling the hidden attribute and changing DOM order. network_policy: The document, its same-origin CSS/JS and its self-hosted fonts are the only requests, all made during initial load. Zero third-party requests.

After document.fonts.ready: searching, filtering, sorting, clearing, opening Check record, and focus or hover make zero requests. There is no fetch, XMLHttpRequest, sendBeacon, WebSocket, EventSource, image beacon, prefetch or preconnect.

The only later request allowed is a navigation the user starts by activating an official source link (target=_blank, rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow", referrerpolicy="no-referrer") or an internal nav link.
No analytics, tag manager, pixel, error reporter or A/B script, and no cookies or Web Storage use.
build_pipeline: 1. Load the seed rows (JSON checked into the repo, never fetched at runtime).
2. Validate each row against row_schema and INV-01 to INV-09. Any failure exits non-zero and prints the row id and error code. There is no partial build.
3. Pre-render the HTML with data-freshness="unconfirmed" on every row.
4. Run the lexicon scan over dist/, then the Playwright acceptance suite.
data_contract.runtime_guard: On every render or filter pass the client re-validates each [data-museum-row] from its data attributes with the same INV rules. A row that fails is hidden and counted in [data-rejected-notice]. Its freshness is recomputed, and no code path creates a control inside a row. Client state therefore cannot turn a stale, unverified or reopened row into anything joinable.

lexicon.engine: ECMAScript RegExp (Node >= 20 / evergreen browsers); rg equivalents use --pcre2 with \x{....} escapes for CJK.
procedure: 1. Collect text per scope: rendered_text = document.body.innerText plus every aria-label / title / placeholder / alt value, for every view listed in acceptance AT-07; control_names = accessible name + visible text + name/id/placeholder of every a, button, input, select, textarea, summary and [role]; hrefs = every a[href], area[href], form[action] resolved with new URL(); built_assets = every file under dist/ (html, css, js, json, svg); built_css = dist/**/*.css plus inline <style>; row_text_not_current = innerText of each [data-museum-row]:not([data-freshness="current"]).

3. Allowlist step: remove every required_copy literal and every group-level allowlisted_literal (longest first, all occurrences) from rendered_text, control_names and built_assets text before scanning. hrefs are never allowlisted.
4. Run every forbidden pattern whose scopes include the scope (add the g flag when scanning). Any match fails the build, printing group id, scope, file or selector, and the matched text.

5. Self-test before use: every should_match sample must match at least one pattern of its group and no should_not_match sample (after the allowlist step) may match any pattern of its group; otherwise the lexicon itself is broken and the build fails.
6. The lexicon file lives in tests/, never in dist/, so a dist scan cannot match its own definitions.

Static: rg -n --pcre2 '\bfetch\(|XMLHttpRequest|sendBeacon|new WebSocket|EventSource|rel="(prefetch|preconnect|dns-prefetch)"|googletagmanager|google-analytics|gtag\(|plausible|segment|sentry' dist/ → exit 1
Positive control: await page.click('a[data-source-link]') with context.on('page') opens exactly one new page whose URL === the row's data-source-url, with no query string.

acceptance.title: Keyboard-only operation and visible focus
steps: Starting at the top, press Tab repeatedly and record document.activeElement. The sequence must match ia.keyboard[0]: skip link, search, status radio, freshness radio, sort select, clear, then for each card its source link and its summary, then the two internal links.

On each stop: getComputedStyle(activeElement).outlineStyle !== 'none' and outlineWidth >= 2px (for radios, the associated label shows it through :has(:focus-visible)), and activeElement.getBoundingClientRect() is not covered by the sticky honesty bar or strip (elementFromPoint at its centre returns the element or a descendant).
Arrow keys on the status group change the checked radio and the shown rows with no Tab. Enter on the skip link moves focus to #collection. Esc in search clears it.
No stop lands inside [data-honesty-bar] or [data-disclosure-strip]; there is no keyboard trap (Tab from the last link reaches the browser chrome or loops to the skip link).
acceptance.pass: The recorded sequence equals the expected list and every focus check passes.
acceptance.fails_if: Any missing or extra stop, an invisible focus ring, focus hidden under a sticky bar, or a trap.

acceptance.title: Reduced motion removes the only animation
steps: await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' }); change a filter; for every [data-museum-row] and details body expect getComputedStyle(el).transitionDuration to match /^0s(, 0s)*$/ and getAnimations().length === 0.

await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'no-preference' }); expect(getComputedStyle(row).transitionProperty).toBe('opacity') and transitionDuration '0.15s'. No element has a transform transition or a CSS animation.
acceptance.pass: Zero-duration transitions and no animations under reduce; only a 150ms opacity transition otherwise.
acceptance.fails_if: Any non-zero transition under reduce, or any animated property other than opacity.

acceptance.title: WCAG AA contrast and structure
steps: node tools/validate-brief.mjs computes the WCAG 2.x contrast of every text token on --bg and --surface and fails below 4.5:1. It also checks --focus and --field-border against --bg and --surface at 3:1 or better.

DOM: for every element with a direct text node, compute the contrast of its computed color against the nearest opaque ancestor background, and require ≥ 4.5 (no text is ≥ 18.66px bold, so the large-text exemption is never used).

Structure: exactly one h1; h1 → h2 → h3 with no skipped level; html[lang='zh-CN']; every English block has lang='en'; each landmark in ia.landmarks exists once; every form control has a programmatic label (labels[0] or aria-labelledby).
acceptance.pass: All ratios meet the threshold and every structure check holds.
acceptance.fails_if: Any ratio below threshold, or any structure check that does not hold.

acceptance.title: Mutation fixtures and client state cannot make a row joinable
steps: Unit: for each fixture, validateRow(fixture.row, { context: fixture.context || "fixtures" }) returns { valid: fixture.expect.valid, code: fixture.expect.error_code }. Together FX-04 to FX-22 mutate verified_on, page_read, status, source_url, as_of, why_not_joinable and the forbidden keys.
Build: inserting any single invalid fixture row into the seed makes `npm run build` exit non-zero and print its error code.

Client state: on the seed page, run page.evaluate(() => { const r = document.querySelector('[data-museum-row]'); r.dataset.status = 'open'; r.dataset.pageRead = 'true'; r.dataset.verifiedOn = '2026-09-23'; }); then change any filter. Expect that row to have the hidden attribute, [data-rejected-notice] to be visible with the text 1 条记录未通过校验，未显示。 / 1 record(s) failed validation and are not shown., and the CTA selectors from AT-02 still to return 0.
Client state: set a row's data-verified-on to the client date while data-page-read stays 'false', then re-filter. That row is hidden as invalid (MUSEUM_E_HEDGE), and no row shows 来源已读取，90 天内已核对.
acceptance.pass: Every unit result matches, the build fails for each invalid row, and both client-state mutations are neutralised.
acceptance.fails_if: Any mismatch, a build that passes with an invalid row, or a mutated row that becomes current, visible as open, or gains a control.

acceptance.title: No horizontal scroll at 320, 360, 640 and 1440
steps: for (const w of [320, 360, 640, 1440]) { await page.setViewportSize({ width: w, height: 800 }); expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth)).toBe(true); }
At 360: every [data-museum-row] satisfies getBoundingClientRect().left >= 16 && right <= innerWidth - 16 (the 16px gutter), and the long Binance source link wraps inside the card.
acceptance.pass: No overflow at any width, and the gutters hold at 360.
acceptance.fails_if: scrollWidth > innerWidth, or a card crossing the 16px gutter.

acceptance.title: The honesty bar and the not-investment-advice line stay in view on narrow screens
steps: At 360×740: after load and after window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight / 2), the rect of [data-honesty-bar] intersects the viewport, and so does the rect of [data-disclosure-strip] (or of footer [data-nia-short] once the footer is on screen).
At 360×420 (a short viewport): both sticky elements compute position: static (reflow fallback), and all text still reflows without horizontal scroll.
acceptance.pass: Both are visible at every scroll position at 360×740, with the static fallback at short heights.
acceptance.fails_if: Either element is scrolled out of view at 360×740, or sticky elements still cover content at 360×420.

acceptance.title: Seed truthfulness on 2026-09-23
steps: For every data_contract.seed row: page_read === false, verified_on === null, as_of === constants.UNVERIFIED_AS_OF, and freshness(row, "2026-09-23") === "unconfirmed". why_not_joinable contains HEDGE_ZH and HEDGE_EN.
The seed contains no cap figure, jurisdiction name, currency, percentage or reward amount: no seed string matches /\d|%|[$€£¥]/, except inside the source_url and the id.

When someone later reads an official page, the row changes only through a commit that sets page_read=true, verified_on=<read date> and as_of=<read date>, and rewrites why_not_joinable from the page text. The test then asserts that the reason no longer contains the hedge and that freshness is current until verified_on + 90 days.
acceptance.pass: All seed rows hold these properties.
acceptance.fails_if: Any seed row claims a read or a date without the evidence commit, or states an unread fact.

acceptance.title: No-JS rendering is safe by default
steps: With JavaScript disabled, every row has data-freshness="unconfirmed" and shows 待核对 / Unconfirmed. The honesty bar, footer disclosure and internal links are present. The filter form keeps its hidden attribute (only the script reveals it), so no GET submission or request is possible. document.querySelectorAll('[data-filter-form]:not([hidden])').length === 0.
acceptance.fails_if: Any row appears current without JS, or any required copy is missing.
